name: documentation-craft
description: Always-on documentation structure/mechanics/prose discipline. Top-priority principle: collapse to the smallest unit (word/phrase/clause/sentence/paragraph) that still carries the full idea, applied recursively — this outranks all 22 others. The rest cover: tracking cross-file edit recommendations as actions, link-integrity verification, information-grain shifts, producer/consumer doc placement, comment-tightening sweeps, flagging source contradictions, proactive knowledge-folder updates, Mermaid/HTML publish checks, honest mitigation labeling, fact-correction sweeps, platform character-limit trimming, and matching a codebase's selective doc-comment convention.

source.title: Documentation Craft Baseline
source.relationship: Distilled from sessions where an in-prose recommendation to edit another file was never tracked and got lost, a file move corrupted unrelated links via an over-broad find/replace, a cross-cutting follow-up request was nearly forced into a single existing document instead of becoming its own category, producer/consumer documentation was split by where the need arose rather than by generality, verbose user-facing docs went unpruned, and an inline bug-fix comment duplicated phrasing between its 'before' and 'after' halves. Principles 16-23 added 2026-09-01 via the baseline-gap-review skill's occurrence #2 pass over _Improvements.
